notes.title: New Game from Salad Fields developer - Stardust Demon!!!
notes.content:
Here's our new game!! It's a retro metroidvania. Check it out and wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815500/Stardust_Demon/

Alongside the action-platformer segments, there will be lots of puzzles too - kind of like Salad Fields, and lots of quirky NPC's. If you like our work, wishlisting really helps us out and enables us to do more. Thank you!!

notes.title: Free DLC - Pumpkinland & More!
notes.content:
Three new areas (free DLC)!!! Accessible in the post-game Starship:

[b]Pumpkinland[/b]
is the biggest, featuring multiple new puzzle types and NPC's. Meet a giant pumpkin (not a pumplin). Fear the new Void Pumplins (not pumpkins) that send any nearby objects or players into the void never to be seen again. Answer quiz questions. And so on!

[b]Walking in the Rain[/b]
is a brisk jaunt through a rainy field on your way to the theatre.

[b]Dungeon Spelunker (1979)[/b]
is a quick look at an old text-adventure that bestows a secret code.



[u]We've also made a couple important additions to the main game:[/u]

There's now a [b]warp pipe[/b] in the skull section of the game...
You now have the option to [b]choose your text speed[/b]! Available in the Esc menu once you've started playing.



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1162430/extras/bar.png?t=1596280511[/img]

[u]Changelog:[/u]

-New area: Pumpkinland
-New area: Walking in the Rain
-New area: Dungeon Spelunker (1979)
-code to unlock post-game areas
-warp pipe NPC added in "The Slaughter Grounds"
-option to change text speed added
-"The Cha-Cha Strut!" puzzle made easier
-fixed some typos maybe

notes.content:

notes.title: Launch!
notes.content:
The game is now complete and not in early access anymore! Big thanks to those who got the game already. :3

The big addition with this update is Part 4, or the final quarter of the game. The main new puzzle mechanic is amoebas, which copy themselves as you move around. There are new exotic locations to explore such as... an art gallery! (so exotic!) We've also made minor enhancements, like a title screen animation when you load up the game.

The future:
Post-game content is in the works! (But first you gotta beat the non-post-game)

notes.title: First major update is here!
notes.content:
Here's what's in it:

-= PART THREE =-

The 3rd chapter (out of 4) is now available and completely done! It's technology-themed and features televisions with cute cat faces, which teleport tiles from one location to another.


-= EXPLORATION MODE =-

There's now 2 difficulty levels, "puzzle mode" and "exploration mode". Exploration mode essentially turns off the puzzles, so that anyone who wants to just experience the story and locations and atmosphere without gameplay now can play through the game. You can switch between the two modes at any point in the game in the pause menu (esc key).


-= other additions =-
- secret areas
- Yippie (the leather-mouse hippie) has their own theme song when they cook you a doughnut
- a bugfix where the game now saves immediately after every vegetable you collect
- minor changes like typos and stuff


..........So how close to completion is the game now?

In terms of chapters this update takes the game from half done to 3/4 done, so there's roughly only 1/4 more game to go. A decent chunk of the cutscenes for the final part are done already and for this update we ended up putting in a lot of extra stuff we weren't expecting so the rest of the game probably won't take us as long as this update took. Then once we leave early access we will update it over time with new optional post-game areas.
